product_overview: Foco no ENEM is a free educational platform to help Brazilian students prepare for the ENEM through AI-powered essay grading, AI quiz generation, curated news, community discussion, and gamified progress tracking.
core_goals: Practice and improve ENEM-style essay writing with detailed AI feedback across the five official competencies
Generate and take targeted multiple-choice quizzes across core ENEM disciplines to measure understanding and receive explanations
Stay informed with curated ENEM-related news and search/filter articles
Discuss topics, share resources and build reputation within a moderated community
Track personal progress, achievements and study streaks via a user dashboard
Support the platform through one-time donations with clear impact information

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Landing hub that introduces the platform, displays key stats and directs users to core experiences.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View hero section, platform statistics, feature highlights and testimonials -> Navigate to /redacao to start writing
Navigate to / -> View hero section, platform statistics, feature highlights and testimonials -> Navigate to /questoes to practice quizzes
Navigate to / -> View hero section, platform statistics, feature highlights and testimonials -> Navigate to /noticias to read news

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password to access account features and personalized data.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Be redirected to /conta and view dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email with incorrect credentials -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See validation error about invalid credentials

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account with email, password and optional profile details to save history and access personalized features.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in email -> Fill in password and observe password strength indicator -> Fill optional profile fields -> Submit registration form -> See confirmation and be redirected to /conta
Navigate to /register -> Fill in email -> Fill in a weak password -> Observe password strength indicator and validation message -> Update password to meet requirements -> Submit registration form

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Request a password recovery email to regain access to an account.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill in email -> Submit recovery request -> See confirmation message instructing next steps via email

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Set a new account password after initiating a recovery request.
user_flows: Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password and observe strength meter -> Confirm new password -> Submit password update -> See success message and navigate to /login
Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill in new password -> Fill in a different confirmation password -> Submit password update -> See validation error indicating passwords do not match

features.name: Essay Writing and AI Correction
features.description: Write ENEM-style essays with theme generation, character counting, and AI grading across five competencies.
user_flows: Navigate to /redacao -> View default theme and support texts -> Request a new random theme -> Type or paste essay text while monitoring character counter -> Submit essay for AI grading -> Observe redirect to results page
Navigate to /redacao -> Type or paste essay text below minimum length -> Attempt to submit essay -> See validation error about minimum character count

features.name: Essay Results
features.description: View detailed AI-generated grading report including overall score, five competency scores and per-competency feedback.
user_flows: Submit an essay from /redacao and arrive at the results view -> View overall score (0-1000) -> View individual competency scores (0-200 each) -> Read per-competency comments, strengths and suggested improvements -> View original essay text -> Navigate to /redacao to write another essay

features.name: Quiz Questions
features.description: Generate AI-created multiple-choice quizzes across five disciplines and review performance with explanations.
user_flows: Navigate to /questoes -> Select one or more disciplines -> Generate quiz -> Answer all multiple-choice questions -> Submit answers -> View results with overall accuracy percentage and per-discipline breakdown -> Read answer explanations
Navigate to /questoes -> Generate quiz -> Attempt to submit answers leaving one or more questions unanswered -> See validation prompt to complete unanswered questions

features.name: Donation
features.description: Make one-time donations via Stripe choosing preset or custom amounts and view a success confirmation with impact details.
user_flows: Navigate to /doacao -> Select a preset amount or enter a custom amount within allowed range -> View impact description for selected tier -> Confirm donation -> Complete payment on Stripe checkout -> Be redirected to /doacao/sucesso and view transaction ID and impact cards
Navigate to /doacao -> Enter a custom amount below the minimum allowed -> Attempt to confirm donation -> See validation error about minimum donation amount

features.name: Community Forum
features.description: Browse and participate in moderated discussions, create posts, like and comment to build reputation.
user_flows: Navigate to /comunidade -> Browse discussion topics and recent posts -> Create a new post -> View the new post in the topic feed -> Like a post -> Comment on a post -> View user profile and reputation

features.name: News
features.description: Browse, filter and search curated ENEM-related news articles and read full articles with related content suggestions.
user_flows: Navigate to /noticias -> Browse news article list -> Filter articles by tags -> Search for articles using keywords -> Open an article to read full content -> View related articles in the sidebar -> Share article via social links

features.name: News Admin
features.description: Admin interface to manage news content including creation, editing, deletion, bulk import and scheduling.
user_flows: Authenticate as an admin and navigate to /noticias/admin -> View list of all articles with statuses -> Create a new article with form inputs and submit -> Edit an existing article and save changes -> Delete an article and confirm removal -> Bulk import articles and review import summary -> Schedule an article for future publishing -> Moderate submitted articles

features.name: Account Dashboard
features.description: Personal dashboard presenting profile, performance statistics, achievements, streaks and progress charts.
user_flows: Authenticate and navigate to /conta -> View profile card with avatar and basic info -> View performance statistics (essays written, accuracy, level/XP) -> View achievement badges and streaks -> View performance charts over time -> Navigate to /conta/editar to update profile

features.name: Edit Account
features.description: Update profile information, change password or delete the user account.
user_flows: Authenticate and navigate to /conta/editar -> Update name, email or bio fields -> Select ENEM year and set study goal -> Upload a profile picture -> Change password by providing current and new passwords -> Submit profile updates -> See confirmation of saved changes
Authenticate and navigate to /conta/editar -> Update email with invalid format -> Attempt to submit changes -> See validation error indicating invalid email

features.name: About Page
features.description: Static page explaining project history, mission and available features.
user_flows: Navigate to /sobre -> Read about project mission, history and values -> View feature overview and timeline

features.name: Terms of Service
features.description: Static page describing usage rules, legal terms and user responsibilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /termos -> Read terms of service content

features.name: Privacy Policy
features.description: LGPD-compliant privacy policy describing data collection, storage and user rights.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacidade -> Read privacy policy content and data handling details

known_limitations.issue: No automated test suite exists yet
known_limitations.impact: All testing is manual; no CI test coverage

known_limitations.issue: API endpoints are restricted to operating hours 7h-23h30 Brasilia time
known_limitations.impact: Essay correction, theme generation, and quiz generation will fail outside operating hours

known_limitations.issue: AI features depend on external Groq API availability and rate limits
known_limitations.impact: Essay grading and quiz generation may fail if Groq API is down or rate limited

known_limitations.issue: Donation flow depends on Stripe test/live mode configuration
known_limitations.impact: Checkout will fail without valid Stripe keys in environment
